matchstick.title: Balance by numeric difference and single‑stick transformation
matchstick.principle: Compute the integer values of both sides, find the numeric difference, and then search for a single‑stick transformation that can adjust the values accordingly. This ensures the moved stick actually resolves the imbalance.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is false and you need to determine which stick move could balance the numeric values.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick without checking the numeric difference, so the equation remains false.

matchstick.title: Convert V to X to add 5
matchstick.principle: If the numeric imbalance is exactly 5 and a V appears, relocate one of V’s diagonal sticks so that the two diagonals cross, turning V into X (value +5).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 5 and a V is present in any numeral.
matchstick.example: Attempting to change a V to X by moving a stick but leaving the V with only one diagonal stick, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Swap I and V in IV to make VI (adds 2)
matchstick.principle: When the imbalance is exactly 2 and the pattern IV appears, move the vertical stick of the I onto the V, forming VI and increasing the value by 2.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 2 and an IV occurs as a numeral.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick of an I to a V without forming a proper VI, leaving an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Change + to - and add I
matchstick.principle: If a plus sign is present and the numeric imbalance can be fixed by decreasing the right‑hand side, remove the vertical stick from '+' to turn it into '-', and place that stick as a new I where needed.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation contains a '+' and the required adjustment is a decrease of 1 (or can be achieved by adding an I).
matchstick.example: Changing '+' to '-' by removing its vertical stick but not using the removed stick to create an I, resulting in a missing numeral.

matchstick.title: Transfer I stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: When the equation is off by 1 and there are isolated I’s, relocate a vertical stick from one I to another numeral, increasing the target’s value by 1 and decreasing the source’s value accordingly.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the numeric imbalance is 1 and at least one standalone I is available to donate a stick.
matchstick.example: Moving a vertical stick from an I but leaving the source I incomplete, resulting in an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Preserve equality sign; never move its sticks
matchstick.principle: When solving a matchstick puzzle, keep the '=' sign unchanged because moving any of its sticks eliminates the equality operator, which cannot be restored with a single stick move.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever the puzzle contains an '=' sign, do not consider moving any of its sticks.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from the '=' sign, turning it into a '-' and leaving the equation without an equality operator.

matchstick.description: Moving a stick from the equality sign
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may treat '=' as interchangeable with other operators and think the missing equality can be compensated elsewhere, but a single stick move cannot preserve a valid equality.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Never relocate any stick from the '=' sign; keep the equality operator intact.
